summary: Recovered the interrupted ambient correction batch. The live G1 source contains corrected, simple primary exteriors; conservative projected footprints; tier-0-complete boat, buoy, and pier topology; and interior-only higher tiers. Targeted F0 schema/hash/vector/render checks pass for all seven definitions. This replaces the stale author report that preceded the 2026-07-17T15:23:34.527Z source correction. It is ready for independent re-review only, not Director acceptance, integration, promotion, or a broader aggregate gate.

corrective_actions.correction: Every primaryPath is now a simple, four-decimal outer boundary of the live tier-0 rendered exterior. The five previously detached primary paths are represented by matching tier-0 complete-exterior surfaces and contain all tier-0 projected vertices.
EVERGREEN_PRIMARY_PATH is a non-self-intersecting union boundary of the three crowns, trunks, and shared plate; the vector audit found no non-adjacent segment crossing.

All footprints are centered projected envelopes rounded outward. The six corrected declared dimensions exceed the review's minimum projected ground envelopes: rock 160x110 over 152x98; truck 188x216 over 176.6692x110; boat 216x200 over 204.382x129; buoy 110x150 over 100x46.4232; pier 350x220 over 332.5538x196; roof kit 164x164 over 152.4204x100. Evergreen remains conservative at 170x130.

Shore-pier silhouette-defining rails and posts are tier 0 in shore-pier-tier-zero-rails-and-posts. Tier 1 is interior deck boards and tier 2 is interior shelter seams only; neither escapes the primary boundary.

Cargo boat has two tier-0 near-side rub rails. Shore pier has tier-0 approach and cross-head support rhythm plus tier-0 rail/post support for the broad T cross-head. Marker buoy retains its weighted faceted body, two stabilizers, mast, and cage at tier 0.
This report records only local corrected-source and targeted validation evidence. It makes no claim of independent acceptance, Director envelope, integration, promotion, or aggregate test success.
